subject.title: feat: add exact-turn capability projection reports

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a versioned cross-runtime capability-audit contract that correlates current reconstructed state with exact recorded turn evidence?
rationale: Current main has the component facts, but maintainers must define the report's authority, correlation semantics, authorization, redaction, retention, platform scope, and publication ownership before implementation.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow design contract
options.body: Define stable run and sequence identifiers, separated evidence layers, strict safe-field schemas, and shared embedded/Codex semantics before accepting implementation.

options.title: Keep diagnostics separate
options.body: Retain `/tools` and trajectory export as independent diagnostics without promising an authoritative unified callability report.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow design contract
recommendation.body: Define stable run and sequence identifiers, separated evidence layers, strict safe-field schemas, and shared embedded/Codex semantics before accepting implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent trajectory ownership is the strongest available routing signal for exact-turn evidence, privacy, and export semantics.
